subject: general
question: Which one of the following is not an operating system?
solution:
The correct answer is** Microsoft Office.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **An operating system** is a piece of system software that controls computer resources, hardware, and common services for software programs.
 
• An operating system is a program that controls all other** application programs in a computer **after being loaded into the system first by a boot program.
 
• **Microsoft Office is a collection of programs** made to increase productivity and carry out typical operations on a computer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​**

 
• **These are some applications for using Linux**: Server OS for shared servers of any kind, including web servers, database servers, file servers, email servers, etc.
 
• **Microsoft Windows is a personal computer operating system** (OS) created by the Microsoft Corporation. It is also known as Windows and Windows OS (PCs).
 
• Apple's desktop OS now has a lot of new features and improvements thanks to **macOS Mojave. Stacks aid in maintaining a neat desktop.** A system-wide dark mode is visually appealing and helps with evening computer use.
